about: Retention steps, deletion requests and upheld abuse reports (ADRs 0104, 0107 and 0108), generated from openblog_core::moderation and checked by crates/openblog-core/tests/participation_protection.rs; netlify/lib/participation-moderation.mjs must agree with every case.
